texts.ThemeIssue:FrontMatterInLayout: This file is used as a layout, and a layout cannot have front matter: a layout cannot choose a layout.
texts.ThemeIssue:DefaultLayoutMissing: The default layout '{Layout}' is not a template of the theme.
texts.ThemeIssue:ReferenceMissing: {Function} names '{Target}', which is not a file of the theme.
texts.ThemeIssue:ReferenceToStaticFile: {Function} names '{Target}', a static file; only a template can be included or used as a layout.
texts.ThemeIssue:AssetUrlToTemplate: asset_url names '{Target}', a template; asset_url takes a static file.
texts.ThemeIssue:IncludeCycle: Templates include each other in a circle: {Chain}.
texts.ThemeIssue:IncludeArgumentMissing: '{Target}' reads the local variable ${Variable}, but this include does not pass it, so rendering fails. Add {Variable}: value to the include, or {Variable}: null when it is optional.
texts.ThemeIssue:RenderFailed: Rendering '{Path}' with the working copy failed: {Message}
texts.ThemeIssue:FragmentReferenceNotFound: '{Path}' links to '#{Id}', but nothing on that page has the id '{Id}': a <use> of a symbol that is not there shows nothing, an anchor goes nowhere. Define it in the page, or point the reference at the file that has it (href="sprite.svg#{Id}").
texts.ThemeIssue:TrialRenderIncomplete: The trial render rendered {Rendered} of {Total} sample pages, the most a check renders ({Max}). Each template was rendered first as a list, as a detail and as a later page, so the pages left out repeat ones that were rendered.
texts.ThemeIssue:TrialRenderOutOfTime: The trial render ran out of its {Seconds} seconds after {Rendered} of {Total} sample pages; the pages after that were not rendered.
texts.ThemeIssue:TrialRenderStopped: The trial render stopped at {Path} after {Rendered} of {Total} sample pages: rendering it failed for a reason that is not the theme's (see the application's log), and the pages after it were not rendered.
texts.ThemeIssue:TrialRenderUnavailable: None of the {Total} sample pages was rendered: this application has neither Dignite.Site.Public.Web, which renders the site, nor RemoteServices:SitePublicWeb naming the application that has it, so a template that fails only when it renders is not found before it is published.
texts.ThemeIssue:LayoutWithoutSiteHead: This file is used as a layout but never calls site_head, not even in what it includes, so every page in it would lose its SEO head tags.
texts.ThemeIssue:PageWithoutSiteHead: This page template renders without a layout and never calls site_head, not even in what it includes.
texts.ThemeIssue:TextFileInvalid: This file holds the theme's texts for a language, but {Message}
texts.ThemeIssue:TextFileDuplicate: '{Other}' already holds the theme's texts for '{Culture}'; a language can have only one file.
texts.ThemeIssue:LanguageVersionWithoutTemplat: This is the version of a template for one language, but the theme has no template '{Template}' for it to be a version of.
texts.ThemeIssue:PathIsFolder: This file's path is also the folder of '{Other}'. One path cannot be both a file and a folder, so the theme could not be exported to a disk: rename one of them.
texts.ThemeIssue:PageRenderedByRazor: The theme has no template '{Template}': the pages {Pages} render through the Razor view of that name.
texts.ThemeIssue:LayoutWithoutBody: This file is used as a layout but never writes {{ body }}, so the page's own content does not appear.
texts.ThemeIssue:MixedRoles: This file is used as a layout, and also {Roles}.
texts.ThemeIssue:UnusedFile: Nothing uses this file: no page, template or setting refers to it.
texts.Description:Site.EnabledLanguages: Comma-separated culture names (e.g. "en,fr,zh-Hans") this site serves. The first one is the default language: its URLs carry no language prefix, while the others are served under "/{culture}/".
texts.Description:Site.PrimaryDomain: The site's primary absolute address, e.g. "https://example.com". Sitemap, robots.txt, feeds and canonical URLs are all built on it, so that a custom domain and a platform subdomain never compete as duplicate content. Leave empty to use the address each request arrives on.
texts.Description:Site.EnableLlmsTxt: Publish an /llms.txt index of this site's pages. Optional and off by default: adoption is around 10% and Google has stated it does not support it, so it is not a ranking mechanism.
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowIndexing: Whether search engines are allowed to index this site.
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowAiTraining: Allow crawlers that train AI models (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot).
texts.Description:Site.Robots.AllowAiSearch: Allow crawlers that power AI search/RAG answers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot).
texts.Description:Site.Branding.AppName: The site's display name. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.Description:Site.Branding.LogoUrl: Logo shown on a light background. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.Description:Site.Branding.LogoReverseUrl: Logo shown on a dark background. Empty uses the platform default.
texts.Description:Site.Seo.DefaultShareImage: The image shared on social networks for a page that has no share image of its own. Empty writes none.
texts.Feature:Site.Enable:Description: Whether this tenant may use Site's management features: the admin UI, the admin API and the MCP tools. A published site is still served either way.
texts.ContentTypeStillHasContents: This content type still has contents; delete or move them first.
texts.Languages:Placeholder: A language tag, e.g. zh-Hans, en, ja
texts.Languages:Hint: The first language is the default: its pages have no language prefix in their address. Every other language is served under /{language}/.
texts.Languages:ChangeWarning: Changing the default language moves the address of every page, and a language left out stops being served until it is added back; its contents are kept.
texts.Seo:Hint: Shown when a page shared on a social network has no share image of its own. An image from the library is cropped to 1200 x 630.
texts.DeletePageConfirmMessage: Delete the page '{0}'? Every content type defined on it, and every content of those types in every language, is deleted with it. This cannot be undone from here.
texts.DisplayName:Page.Name: Name
texts.Description:Page.Name: The page's identifier, used by MCP tools and templates. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore only, e.g. "blog-posts".
texts.Description:Page.Route: This page's own address, e.g. "/about". Add "{slug}" (or "{slug?}") to give it content, e.g. "/blog/{slug}"; "{slug:^(privacy|terms)$}" also limits which slugs are allowed. No spaces. Use "/" to make this page the home page.
texts.Description:Page.Template: The template rendered for this page, whether a request resolves to the page itself (a list) or to one piece of content beneath it (a detail view) - the template decides which case it's in. The theme's template at this path is used, else the Razor view of that name. E.g. "Default" or "blog/post". Letters, digits, hyphen, underscore and "/" only, required.
texts.Description:Page.ParentId: The page this one is organized under in the admin UI. Organizational only - it does not affect routing. Leave empty for a top-level page.
texts.SetAsDefaultLayoutHint: Use this layout for page templates whose front matter names none. Like a file, it goes live with the next publish.
texts.IsDefaultLayoutHint: This is already the default layout.
texts.ExportThemeHint: Download the working copy as a zip package
texts.ExportReleaseHint: Download this release as a zip package
